policy_prompt_for_subgoal: An episode starts in subgoal A (pick up the cube). Rules, applied to whatever the step shows: The held/not-held test is the finger opening in the scene at this decision step, not the cube line (the cube line may still report its old table position without a 'held' label while the cube is in fact held). 1. If the fingers are ~100% open (nothing held): choose A, pick up the cube, pointing at the current position of the goal-named cube as shown in the scene at this decision step (typically near [82, 127] at the start of execution). This is always the case at the first decision step. 2. If the fingers are ~46% open with the gripper raised (height around 0.15), the goal-named cube is held, regardless of whether the cube line carries a 'held' label or reports a stale table position (the execution steps just shown will show the fingers closing from 100% to ~46% at table height on the cube and not reopening): choose B, drop onto, pointing at goal_target from memory, which is already the target's execution-time position; confirm by taking the target in the current scene nearest to goal_target (within a few pixels) and point at that listed position. If goal_target is unknown but demo_placements is non-empty, use the entry the goal ordinal selects (first=1, second=2, third=3, fourth=4) only if a target currently stands within a few pixels of it; otherwise fall to rule 4. 3. Never choose C (press the button); the button is part of the demonstration only, not of the task. 4. If the situation matches no rule (e.g. the cube is held but memory is empty and no list can be derived, or the cube is not visible): if a cube is held, drop onto the target nearest the image centre; otherwise choose A pointing at the goal-named cube's last visible position. After a drop has been completed the episode is over; if asked again, repeat rule 1 or 2 as the scene dictates.

fields.name: demo_placements
fields.description: At the first decision step (the one that shows DEMONSTRATION STEPS and the memory is empty), scan the demo frames for the cube whose colour the goal instruction names, and write the ordered list of target positions, in [y, x], where it was released: a release is a frame where the fingers open from ~46% to ~100% right after frames where that cube was 'held in the gripper'; record the target of the STABLE demo target set (the four positions that stay the same through the demo, as listed in the frames just before the final centre release) that is closest to where the cube now rests, even if that target is missing from the release frame itself because the gripper hides it. Do NOT read target positions from the last demo frames: near the end of the demo, while the gripper is parked raised at about [54, 128], height 0.200, two targets may slide to new positions over a few frames (positions appear that match no earlier target) and the final frames show the shuffled layout. Skip the demo's final release near the image centre (cube left around [82, 127] with no target there), skip the cube's starting spot, and skip button presses (fingers 0% open, no cube held). At every later step, copy the carried-in value unchanged. Empty list if no demonstration frames are shown and nothing is carried in. e.g. [[137, 103], [115, 85]]

fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: At the first decision step, after writing demo_placements, take the entry of demo_placements the goal ordinal selects ('first' = entry 1, 'second' = entry 2, 'third' = entry 3, 'fourth' = entry 4). Then look at the parked frames at the end of the demonstration (gripper at about [54, 128], height 0.200, fingers 100% open, lasting many frames). If across those frames the target list changes, that target may have moved: follow it frame by frame, each time taking the newly listed position nearest to where it was, ignoring positions that belong to targets that did not move, until the list stops changing; write its settled position as a [y, x] point, which must equal one of the four target positions in the first execution frame. If the target list never changes in the parked frames, write the demo_placements entry itself. This is the point to drop onto later. At every later step copy the carried-in value unchanged. unknown if demo_placements is empty. e.g. entry 1 is [137, 103]; in the parked frames a target goes [137, 104] -> [115, 110] -> [98, 135] -> [100, 164] -> [101, 166] while the target from [101, 169] goes to [137, 103]; goal_target = [101, 166]
